name: Gilbert (United States)
description: "The Star of Bright Promise": a purple field with a large eight-pointed star of white and gold towards the hoist, from which pale purple rays extend to the hoist and fly.
history: Gilbert is a town in Mingo County, West Virginia, on the Guyandotte River. On 1 July 2023, after a months-long design contest, the town announced its new flag, "The Star of Bright Promise".

features.role: eight-pointed star of white and gold, the Star of Bright Promise
pale purple rays extending from the star
